changesBeforeEdit: On signedOut revoke pending read epochs, suspend media, clear image/history/context/selection and action state; retain account choices for explicit reauthentication.

Actual profile CU found a pinned socialContext labelled as repost. Separate explicit pinned boolean through projection/native/frontend; display a noninteractive pin label, and retain repost navigation only for explicit repost context. Evidence x-flow2-problem-pinned-repost.jpg.

Existing debug observations reached their 2MiB cap before this run. Preserve the old file and use a per-process bounded debug-only file with timestamps for current verification. Do not collect credentials, raw URLs, media, HTML or post bodies.

Preserve prior explicit reply/related evidence when same-view append omits classification; new explicit evidence still wins. Identity-less quoted video posters may be enlarged as observed images only, never assigned an inferred post ID or enabled for playback/actions. Avoid zero-of-zero image viewer for this case.

Regression proves resume status can report account B while retained account A cards remain until the new read finishes. Gate cards/media on status readiness and discard retained views, navigation and pending epochs when status active identity or generation changes.
